seo.title: 530 Spray Foam — Insulation in Redding & the North Valley
seo.description: Closed-cell and open-cell spray foam insulation across Shasta, Tehama, Butte and Glenn. Free walkthrough, fixed-price quote, 10-year workmanship warranty.

hero.lede: A 2,000 sq ft home in Redding loses roughly a third of its conditioned air through the attic. Foam stops it in a day — and we file the utility rebate for you.

foam.heading: Open cell or closed cell?
foam.sub: Both are foam. Which one you want comes down to where it's going and what it has to stop.

cards.name: Open cell
cards.body: Softer, breathable, best value for attics and interior walls. Great sound damping between bedrooms and shops.

cards.name: Closed cell
cards.body: Rigid, vapor-tight, adds structural rigidity. The pick for crawlspaces, metal buildings and exterior assemblies.

foam.specNote: Full submittal packet, ICC-ES reports and Title 24 docs available on request.

items.quote: Crew masked everything, sprayed the whole crawlspace in a day, and my floors aren't freezing anymore. Bill dropped $90 the first month.
Upstairs used to run ten degrees hotter than down. They foamed the roof deck and the AC finally shuts off in the afternoon.
Sprayed our 40×60 shop in two days, masked the whole slab, and the condensation drip off the metal is completely gone.
Fixed price, showed up when they said, and filed the rebate paperwork without me chasing it. Framers had zero delay.
